entries.title: Psalms 114:1
segments: ¶When Israel went out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language,

entries.title: Psalms 114:2
segments: Judah became His sanctuary, [And] Israel His dominion.

entries.title: Psalms 114:3
segments: The sea saw [it] and fled; Jordan turned back.

entries.title: Psalms 114:4
segments: The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.

entries.title: Psalms 114:5
segments: What ails you, O sea, that you fled? O Jordan, [that] you turned back?

entries.title: Psalms 114:6
segments: O mountains, [that] you skipped like rams? O little hills, like lambs?

entries.title: Psalms 114:7
segments: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob,

entries.title: Psalms 114:8
segments: Who turned the rock [into] a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.
